exampleEn: We need to dress up for the wedding this weekend.
exampleKo: 이번 주말 결혼식에 맞춰 세련되게 차려 입어야 해.
gameExamples: I love to dress up for Halloween parties and show off my costume.
It's important to dress up for job interviews to make a good impression.
Every year, we dress up for the charity gala and raise money for a good cause.
